`bun tools/check-register.ts` exited 0 across 436 items. No risk at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled. All four of its checks came back 0: unsettled at Likelihood 3 or higher, settled with no Verified line, Moved Out for a reason other than a part not shipped, and two Likelihood values.

The checker reads the last `Status:` in each entry. 38 entries at Likelihood 3 or higher carry more than one Status line. I re-parsed them with the checker's own rules, in a scratch script outside the repo, and every one ends on a settled status. Earlier lines differ in each: `open` or `partial`, and one of RISK-410's is `closed`. Each reason below is cut at about 90 characters of the entry's last Status line, so read the entry for the rest.
